body:
# GravesPro

[![minecraft-title(1).png](https://i.postimg.cc/wMxbmJSb/minecraft-title(1).png)](https://postimg.cc/N9V4hyG1)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0--SNAPSHOT-blue)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/gravespro)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper%20%7C%20Purpur-informational)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-orange)](https://www.oracle.com/java/)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-green)](https://www.minecraft.net/)

**GravesPro** is a high-performance death management system for modern Minecraft servers.  
The plugin ensures reliable preservation of players’ items after death while providing flexible configuration for administrators and an intuitive user interface.

---

##  Key Features

###  Advanced Grave Mechanics
- Automatic grave creation at the player’s death location
- Customizable grave blocks (player heads or any block type)
- Grave expiration system with automatic cleanup
- Experience (XP) storage with configurable return percentage

###  Intuitive Interface
- Clean Grave View GUI (items, death reason, coordinates)
- Simple item recovery via GUI or interaction
- Death history tracking for players and admins

### Visualization & Effects
- Built-in holograms using native Display Entities (no dependencies)
- Particle effects for easier grave location
- Custom model support (Oraxen, ItemsAdder, Nexo)

###  Security & Protection
- Private graves (access control system)
- Team/shared access support
- Protection from explosions, fire, and block destruction

###  Performance & Reliability
- SQLite & MySQL database support
- Optimized for minimal MSPT impact
- Developer-friendly API for extensions

---

##  Integrations
- PlaceholderAPI support (holograms & messages)
- DecentHolograms / CMI optional compatibility
- Oraxen, ItemsAdder, Nexo item providers support

---

##  Commands & Permissions

### Commands
- `/grave` — Main command (`gravespro.use`)
- `/grave history` — View death history
- `/grave admin` — Admin tools (`gravespro.admin`)

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft: **1.21+**
- Java: **21+**
- Server software: **Paper / Purpur**

---

##  Notes
This plugin is designed for modern high-performance servers and aims to minimize server load while providing rich gameplay mechanics for death recovery systems.
